name: Tailwind CSS Design Tokens
description: Enforces CSS variable-based design tokens with Tailwind for consistent, themeable UI systems.
content:
# Tailwind CSS Design Tokens Rules

- Define all design tokens as CSS custom properties — colors, spacing, typography, shadows, borders
- Use `:root` for light theme tokens and `.dark` or `[data-theme='dark']` for dark theme overrides
- Reference tokens in Tailwind config — `colors: { primary: 'var(--color-primary)' }` instead of hardcoded hex values
- Never use raw color values (`#3B82F6`, `blue-500`) in components — always use semantic token names (`primary`, `surface`, `muted`)
- Create a semantic color scale — `--color-surface-primary`, `--color-surface-secondary`, `--color-text-primary`, `--color-text-muted`
- Use token-based spacing for layout consistency — extend Tailwind's spacing scale with your design system values
- Define typography tokens — `--font-size-heading`, `--font-weight-heading`, `--line-height-body` for consistent text styles
- Use CSS variables for shadow tokens — `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md`, `--shadow-lg` that adapt to light/dark themes
- Keep token names semantic, not descriptive — `--color-danger` not `--color-red`, `--spacing-page` not `--spacing-32`
- Store tokens in a single CSS file (`tokens.css` or `variables.css`) — import before Tailwind layers
- Support theme switching at runtime — toggling a class on `<html>` should change all colors via CSS variables
- Document your token system — maintain a living style guide showing all available tokens and their values
